11/11/2024
Claim opened after a low-speed head-on collision reported by the claimant, who is not represented by an attorney.
The claimant reports a shoulder injury and says the vehicle was driven by a household member of the policyholder at
the time.
11/13/2024
Reviewed the claim file and confirmed the policy was in force on the date of loss. Nothing in the records suggests the
damage occurred bfeore coverage began.
12/27/2024
Spkoe with the claimant, who described the collision in the same sequence as the first report. Noted that the claimant
recalled a few additional small details but the core account did not change.
01/12/2025
Police report reviewed. Responding officers confirm the claimant was present in the vehicle at the scene, and the
other driver's statement matches the claimant's description of how the impact occurred.
01/22/2025
Obtained scene photographs and statements from two independent witnesses. Both witnesses describe the collision
as happening the way the clamiant and the other driver described it.
02/15/2025
Inspected the vehicle. The front-end damage is consistent with a low-speed frontal impact. No earlier damage to the
vehicle is known from prior claims or reapir records.
03/16/2025
Reviewed the medical records. The reported shoulder injury fits the type and force of this collision well. No prior injury
to the same body area is known from the claimant's history.
03/29/2025
Treatmnet followed a usual course, with physical therapy and follow-up visits. The treating provider's notes show
steady improvement, and the frequency of visits has tapered as the claimant recovered.
04/04/2025
Reviewed the damage estimate against the photographs. It is not yet clear whether all of the listed damage came
from this impact, so the estimate is being held for further review.
05/02/2025
Sent the claimant a written request for any additional documentation of the treatment and the repair work. The
claimant was reminded of the option to seek representation at any point.
05/05/2025
Coverage and liability reviewed together. The driver is a household member of the policyholder and qualifies for
coverage under the policy terms. Liability evaluation is progressing on the basis of the consistent accounts.
05/21/2025
File updated with the current treatment status and the open damage question. Next step is to finalize the estimate
review and confirm the remaining medical bills before a settlement recommendation is made.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
